_about: THE per-builder offer, approved by Brandon 2026-09-19 12:58 CDT (DECISIONS_QUEUE D-168). Keys are Elementor's own widget slugs (titles in BUILDER_WIDGET_CATALOG_2026-09-17.*.json); `ia` are OUR widgets and exist ONLY as database twins of an Elementor widget or because no normal widget can do the job. A widget not listed for a builder is NOT offered there. Nothing else may appear on a panel.
layout: widgets panel on the LEFT (Elementor's groups and order, tiles two across); settings of the selected element on the RIGHT in Content / Style / Advanced; Structure is a floating window; Add section -> Blank (flexbox container, then structure) or Template (section templates).

ia_twins.product_cards: twin of Price Table / Call to Action: title, text, image, price, tags; pick products or services from the catalogue and it pre-fills
ia_twins.product_line_items: twin of Price List, laid out like the quote and invoice line items; pick from the catalogue
ia_twins.totals: discounts, sales tax, estimated total under the line items
ia_twins.custom_field: ONE widget: pick one database field (customer, service location, business; lumen contacts shared by OLIVER and SPARK); styled like text; editable in place
ia_twins.ia_reviews: twin of Reviews: the business's real reviews
ia_twins.ia_form: twin of Form: submissions go to SPARK
ia_twins.book_now: twin of Button: links to the booking page
ia_twins.ia_posts: twin of Posts (exists in the plugin)
ia_twins.unsubscribe_footer: email only, required by law, cannot be removed
ia_twins.brand_logo: My Brand: the logo from the brand kit
ia_twins.product_card: My Brand: one promo card with a real product name and price
ia_twins.ia_review: My Brand: one real review as a graphic
ia_twins.table: a plain table of rows and columns. KEPT, not invented: Elementor has NO table widget, free or Pro (the only matches in both machine files are price-table and table-of-contents); this one already exists in the build as kind `data_table` (label Table), and the shipped templates use it, including the Commercial snow & ice agreement. It was left off the first version of this file by mistake (added 2026-09-19 13:50 after the proposals research flagged it and the main session verified all four facts). Proposal only for now; other builders are a candidate, not a decision.

website.pro_rule: offered on ARION Standard and up; on Lite the tile shows a padlock and the group header an Upgrade link

landing.note: same as website without the site and blog-post pieces and menus

newsletter.note: video shows as a clickable picture; also used by email templates and automations

proposal.note: quotes and invoices use the same list

also.website_headers_and_footers: the site pieces: Site Logo, Menu, Search
also.forms: the IA Form widget's own field editor, as Elementor's Form
